# `reports/gadget_pkdgrav3_potential/make_ximult_phi_figures.py`

Source: [make_ximult_phi_figures.py](../../../../reports/gadget_pkdgrav3_potential/make_ximult_phi_figures.py)

```text
Gravitational-redshift dipole of the three matched-seed 512^3 boxes (L = 200, 500, 1000 Mpc/h, z = 0) for every
halo potential column of the vahc catalogue (.vpot), from scripts/post-process/halo_xi_multipoles.py with
--phi <12 columns> --los x,y,z (pawna job 2539117, 24 Nov 2026; /user/shadab/ximult_phi/job.pbs).

usage: make_ximult_phi_figures.py [--d data/box512_L200_L500_L1000] [--figs figs] [--table ximult512_phi_table.tex]
  data: L<box>_out100_ximult_phiall.npz, reduced copies (no DD, no jackknife regions, real-space xi of the even
        multipoles only) of the archived
        /storage/shadab/sahyadri_sims/halos/Sahyadri_L<box>N512/default512/r1/xcorr/out_100_ximult_phiall.npz
  figs/ximult512_phi_vg.pdf      mean v_g = -phi/c per mass bin for each potential column, the three boxes
  figs/ximult512_phi_dipole.pdf  dipole averaged over s = 10-40 Mpc/h for each column: grav - real and
                                 rsd+grav - rsd, four cross pairs, with the mean-shift estimate
  figs/ximult512_phi_s.pdf       L1000 pair 1-3: dipole against s for five columns, with their mean-shift estimates
  ximult512_phi_table.tex        the 10-40 Mpc/h dipole of the best-measured pairs for each column
  log-s bins (100 from 0.01 to 100 Mpc/h, --sbins log:0.01,100,100, pawna job 2539125; L<box>_..._phiall_log.npz,
  archived as .../xcorr/out_100_ximult_phiall_log.npz):
  figs/ximult512_phi_logs.pdf    s^2 x dipole difference against log s, five columns, L1000 1-3 and L500 0-2
  ximult512_phi_log_table.tex    dipole (grav - real) averaged over 1-3, 3-10, 10-40 Mpc/h for each column
Averages over 10-40 Mpc/h as make_ximult_box_figures.py: inverse-variance weights of the 2 Mpc/h bins (jackknife
errors, bins treated as independent); the mean-shift estimate -(<v_g>_B - <v_g>_A)/(aH) dxi_0^real/ds averaged with
the same weights.
```

## Contents

- [`load`](#load) - Load `L<L>_out100_ximult_phiall<suffix>.npz` of every box into a dict, adding `pairs_l` (pairs as tuples), `cols` (the potential column names) and `dn` (names of the differences).
- [`style`](#style) - Common axis style of the report figures.
- [`estimate`](#estimate) - mean-shift estimate -(&lt;v\_g&gt;\_B - &lt;v\_g&gt;\_A)/(aH) dxi\_0^real/ds against s
- [`dipole`](#dipole) - dipole difference (kd: 0 grav - real, 1 rsd+grav - rsd) against s, its error
- [`avg`](#avg) - (mean, error, mean-shift estimate) over smin &lt; s &lt; smax, inverse-variance weights
- [`skip`](#skip) - True for the pairs not shown: the top mass bin of L = 200 (76 halos, jackknife errors unreliable).
- [`sep`](#sep) - Dashed vertical line between the sphere columns and the smoothed-grid columns.
- [`fig_vg`](#fig_vg) - Figure: mean v\_g per mass bin for each of the twelve potential columns, per box.
- [`fig_dipole`](#fig_dipole) - Figure: 10-40 Mpc/h dipole for each potential column and pair, measured against the mean-shift estimate (grav and rsd+grav).
- [`rebin`](#rebin) - Average the last axis of `x` over groups of `n` bins (a remainder is dropped).
- [`rebin_err`](#rebin_err) - Error of `rebin` for independent errors `e`: sqrt(sum e^2) / n.
- [`fig_s`](#fig_s) - Figure: dipole difference against s for L1000 pair 1-3, selected potential columns.
- [`wavg`](#wavg) - inverse-variance mean of y[m] over bins with pairs (e &gt; 0); (nan, nan) if none
- [`log_rebin`](#log_rebin) - groups of n log bins: geometric-mean s, inverse-variance mean of the bins with pairs
- [`fig_logs`](#fig_logs) - Figure: s^2 x dipole difference against log s for the logarithmic-bin runs (`LOG_PANELS`).
- [`table_log`](#table_log) - dipole (grav - real) averaged over 1-3, 3-10 and 10-40 Mpc/h in the log bins, L1000 1-3 and L500 0-2
- [`table`](#table) - LaTeX table of the dipole per potential column (L1000 pair 1-3 and others) with the v\_g difference.
- [`main`](#main) - Command line: the multi-potential dipole figures and tables (linear and logarithmic bins).

## load

```python
load(d, suffix='')
```

Load `L<L>_out100_ximult_phiall<suffix>.npz` of every box into a dict, adding `pairs_l` (pairs as
tuples), `cols` (the potential column names) and `dn` (names of the differences).
